answer.short:
$AB$: rise $1$, run $2$, gradient $\frac12$.

$AC$: rise $2$, run $4$, gradient $\frac12$.

$AD$: rise $3$, run $6$, gradient $\frac12$.

$BC$: rise $1$, run $2$, gradient $\frac12$.

$BD$: rise $2$, run $4$, gradient $\frac12$.

$CD$: rise $1$, run $2$, gradient $\frac12$.
answer.worked:
Count the vertical rise and horizontal run from left to right.

$$\begin{align*}m_{AB}&=\frac{1}{2}\\m_{AC}&=\frac{2}{4}=\frac12\\m_{AD}&=\frac{3}{6}=\frac12\\m_{BC}&=\frac{1}{2}\\m_{BD}&=\frac{2}{4}=\frac12\\m_{CD}&=\frac{1}{2}\end{align*}$$

answer.worked:
The horizontal side is $5$ units. Using rise and run for the other two sides:
$$\begin{align*}
d_1 &= \sqrt{(-4)^2+(-1)^2} \\
&= \sqrt{17}\text{ units} \\
d_2 &= \sqrt{4^2+(-4)^2} \\
&= \sqrt{32}\text{ units} \\
P &= 100(5+\sqrt{17}+\sqrt{32})\text{ m} \\
&\approx 1478\text{ m}
\end{align*}$$
The perimeter is $1478\text{ m}$ to the nearest metre.
